newsitem.title: BELGIUM: TABLE - Belgian July inflation seen up - poll.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - Belgian July inflation seen up - poll.

text.p: Belgian year-on-year inflation was expected to be on average 1.69 percent in July, this month's Reuter poll of forecasters showed.
Month-on-month, July inflation is seen at an average 0.58 percent. Consumer price inflation data are due on July 29.
Inflation stood at a month-on-month 0.17 percent in June for a year-on-year 1.79 percent.

NOTE - Geert Noels, Chief Economist at Petercam, attributed the rise in July's CPI to higher fresh food prices and higher energy prices (dollar-effect). Generale Bank and JP Morgan analysts also noted the higher food prices.
